# Director Test Script

A minimal two-scene script used by the test playbook (TESTING.md). Edit
`PRODUCT_NAME` / `PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION` in `.env` to retarget the scoring prompt.

[scene 1]
Welcome to Director — an AI video production pipeline that turns a script
like this one into a finished video.

[scene 2]
Pick your providers, run one command, and watch the seven phases stream
to the final output.
